result.instructions: Tools for Nylas, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Nylas data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run nylas_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run nylas_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run nylas_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. nylas_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: nylas_list_grants
tools.title: List grants (connected accounts)
tools.description: List the connected accounts (grants) on this Nylas application, each with a grant_id used to scope other tools. Not grant-scoped. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants.

tools.name: nylas_get_grant
tools.title: Get a grant
tools.description: Get details for a single connected account (grant). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}.

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

tools.name: nylas_list_messages
tools.title: List messages
tools.description: List email messages for the connected account, with optional filters. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages.

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

page_token.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a prior page).

unread.description: If set, filter by unread status.

starred.description: If set, filter by starred status.

tools.name: nylas_get_message
tools.title: Get a message
tools.description: Get a single email message by id. Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages/{message_id}.

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

tools.name: nylas_list_folders

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

tools.name: nylas_list_calendars
tools.title: List calendars

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

page_token.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a prior page).

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

tools.name: nylas_list_events
tools.title: List events
tools.description: List calendar events. Requires calendar_id (sent as a query param). Nylas v3: GET /v3/grants/{grant_id}/events.

calendar_id.description: REQUIRED. The calendar id (sent as a query param).

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

page_token.description: Pagination cursor (next_cursor from a prior page).

start.description: Filter: earliest event start, Unix timestamp (seconds).

end.description: Filter: latest event start, Unix timestamp (seconds).

calendar_id.description: REQUIRED. The calendar id (sent as a query param).

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

tools.name: nylas_send_message
tools.title: Send an email
tools.description: SENDS a real email via the connected account. This dispatches an actual message. Nylas v3: POST /v3/grants/{grant_id}/messages/send.

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

reply_to_message_id.description: Id of the message this is a reply to.

tools.name: nylas_create_event
tools.title: Create a calendar event
tools.description: Creates a calendar event (may send invites to participants). Requires calendar_id (sent as a query param). Nylas v3: POST /v3/grants/{grant_id}/events.

calendar_id.description: REQUIRED. The calendar id to create the event in (sent as a query param).

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.

tools.name: nylas_create_draft
tools.title: Create a draft email
tools.description: Creates a draft email (does NOT send — safe/additive). Nylas v3: POST /v3/grants/{grant_id}/drafts.

grant_id.description: Connected-account grant id. Overrides NYLAS_GRANT_ID for this call.
